title: Macronix AN0719 migration from MX30LF2G18AC to MX30LF2G28AD
note: Reference for manufacturer-recommended successor only; no BOM substitution made. Preliminary note; 18AC and 28AD have different spare-area sizes and 4-bit versus 8-bit ECC requirements.
first_page_excerpt: Migrating from MX30LF2G18AC to MX30LF2G28AD 1 P/N: AN0719 REV. 2, December 27, 2019 APPLICATION NOTE Preliminary 1. Introduction This application note is a guide for migrating Macronix NAND device from the MX30LF2G18AC to the MX30LF2G28AD. The document does not provide detailed information on the individual devices, but highlights the major similarities and differences between them. The comparison covers the general features, performance, command codes and other differences. The information in this document is based on datasheets listed in Section 8. Newer versions of the datasheets may override the contents of this document. 2. General Features Feature differences are highlighted in Bold Italic type in the table. Table 2-1.
